# bc-find-bugs relationships

Source of truth is [concepts/relationships.json](../relationships.json). Regenerate with
`python3 scripts/lint.py --write-relationships`; `python3 scripts/lint.py` fails while this file is stale.

## Outgoing

- adapts `bc-improve-codebase-architecture` — required, when filing after the owner answers.
  Report-then-owner filing, roles and the no-pipeline fallback mirror bc-improve-codebase-architecture.
  Source: [CONCEPT.md](CONCEPT.md)

- hands off to `bc-plan-to-pipeline` — required, when after filing into a project work pipeline.
  Once its filing is committed it runs bc-plan-to-pipeline from a settled source on each work-planned item it filed, passing the owner's filing answer and the report; bc-council-find-bugs inherits this through bc-find-bugs §5.
  Source: [body/SKILL.md](body/SKILL.md#5-file-after-the-owner-answers)

- loads `bc-safe-runs` — required, when running tests, making scratch folders, full suites, worktrees, workers or worktree removal.
  Storage-safe run and worktree-removal rules have one home in bc-safe-runs (derived from the agent kernel's Storage safety); the body keeps a one-line fallback for when the skill is not installed, which a change to the module's rules must update.
  Source: [body/SKILL.md](body/SKILL.md#3-reproduce)

- hands off to `bc-security-audit` — optional, when a security hole is seen in passing.
  Security holes are reported with a pointer and audited by bc-security-audit, not here.
  Source: [body/SKILL.md](body/SKILL.md#2-hunt)

- depends on `bc-setup-project`'s contract — required, when filing into a work pipeline.
  Relies on the work-item template, Kind placement in order.md and work_index.py --check. Numbers items under its worktree numbering rule.
  Source: [CONCEPT.md](CONCEPT.md)

- adapts `bc-tdd` — required, when every reproduction.
  A reproduction counts only when it fails for the stated reason, tdd's watched-fail rule.
  Source: [body/SKILL.md](body/SKILL.md#3-reproduce)

## Incoming

- incoming from [bc-council-find-bugs](../bc-council-find-bugs/RELATIONSHIPS.md): loads this concept — required, when every council bug hunt.
  Scope, hunted kinds, candidate block, reproduction, report and filing have one home in bc-find-bugs.
  Source: [bc-council-find-bugs/body/SKILL.md](../bc-council-find-bugs/body/SKILL.md)
